title: It’s not simple, it’s complicated.
text:
It’s not simple, it’s complicated.. This Simplicity lightweight cordless vacuum cleaner is okay... but there are better options out there for the same price. Unfortunately, I just came across too many flaws/cons with this one.

I’ll start off with what I like: It’s lightweight and very flexible. It’s easy to maneuver across the floor or in corners with no issues. The filter is easy to empty and there is a low and high setting to choose from.

Now for the cons: First of all, the packaging was a bit odd... I am glad I checked the bottom of the box underneath the styrofoam, as pieces were hidden down there... I was so close to throwing these away!

The next thing I don’t understand is the charging station. It’s a strange concept. You have to detach the vacuum to lock it in. You also need both hands to place in the station, which is a bit of a pain. It looks like a train 🚂 once in the charging station. Also, the directions mention nothing of this... Which was a bit frustrating to figure it out. It’s a pain to have to re-assemble every time you want to vacuum as well... The name Simplicity should be simple... and I personally found this too complicated.
